verdict.rationale: Base44 documents first-party ways to take your app's code out: GitHub sync, and the CLI eject command, which downloads frontend code and backend resources. That covers code and configuration portability. Ejected projects still get a new Base44 app ID, though, and nothing documents exporting app records (for example CSV or JSON from the Data page) or running the app fully off-platform. Community notes also say the database is built into the platform. missing for 10: documented bulk export of app data records in open formats, evidence that exported apps can run independently of Base44's managed backend, independent hands-on corroboration of a full exit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
